nameOrigin: common cloud suffix; possession of a given quality

pokedexEntries.bk: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

pokedexEntries.wh: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.
